final_answer:
**Analysis:**

Both figures come from the same filing (Apple's FY2024 Form 10-K), covering comparable fiscal years (FY2023 and FY2024) on a consistent basis, so the comparison is valid. [DOC-1]

**Calculations:**

- FY2023 R&D as % of revenue: $29,915M / $383,285M = 7.80% [DOC-1]
- FY2024 R&D as % of revenue: $31,370M / $391,035M = 8.02% [DOC-1]

**Change:** 8.02% − 7.80% = **0.22 percentage point increase**

R&D spending as a percentage of revenue increased slightly from FY2023 to FY2024, rising from approximately 7.80% to 8.02%, an increase of about 0.22 percentage points. This reflects R&D growing faster (5.9% YoY) than revenue (2.0% YoY) year-over-year. [DOC-1]

ANSWER: Increased by approximately 0.22 percentage points (from ~7.80% in FY2023 to ~8.02% in FY2024)
